mainEntity.name: Which facial should I choose for acne-prone skin?

acceptedAnswer.text: Start with a Custom Facial and tell your provider that acne-prone skin or congestion is your priority. Clear + Balance is the related skin-goal pathway. Suitability and treatment steps are decided after reviewing your skin and routine.

Matrix offers personalized cosmetic facial care for acne-prone skin through the Custom Facial. Cleansing, suitable exfoliation, masks and hydration are selected for the individual. Facials do not replace medical acne treatment or guarantee clear skin.

mainEntity.name: Are extractions included in every facial?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Extractions are considered only when appropriate for your skin, comfort and booked appointment. Discuss congestion and active breakouts with your provider before treatment.

mainEntity.name: What should I share before my appointment?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tell us about allergies, sensitivities, current skincare, prescription products, recent peels or waxing, and any active irritation. Follow your prescriber’s directions; ask about treatment timing if you are unsure.

mainEntity.name: Can I combine facial care with a Head Spa?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The current menu includes Matrix Head Spa + Hydrating Glow Facial, which pairs customized scalp care with a mini facial, facial massage and hydration. Review its current details when booking.
